reason: The supplied history has no eligible promotion and shows noisy or mixed outcomes for K-loop changes, so I rank those proposals below simpler traversal and address tests. The A-panel transpose proposal could reduce transpose cost, but changes packing and consumption together and adds timed work; its full-call benefit is uncertain, especially for small n. Tail overflow handling is a correctness improvement with no claimed speed gain. All performance proposals remain hypotheses pending fresh paired measurements.
